findings.rawBody:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require all 15 reviewed sources in the migration lease**

The guard requires only the first nine `LayoutSourcePaths`, so an activation manifest can omit the six modified fixture/assertion files and still pass. In that case those files are never hash-checked by `LayoutCheckFiles`, allowing the one-shot native migration and its evidence to run against test inputs that differ from the reviewed head; require the activation source set to equal all 15 paths exactly.

findings.rawBody:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear the layout gate when disabling the component**

If this component is disabled after an invalid safe-area sample without a host `Unbind`—for example by toggling the component during presentation—`OnDisable` only unsubscribes, leaving `LayoutDiagnostic` active and the battle `CanvasGroup` non-interactable indefinitely. It should release the diagnostic/interaction gate just as `Unbind` does while preserving the last valid geometry.
